scope.summary: Author the skinny/slender channels per Section 13.17 (BK-17.3, TAI-BK-049), closing REQ-016: subcutaneous_fat (removal toward skeletal visibility), rib_visibility, hip_bone_visibility — each with EXPLICIT exclusion of the breast and glute masks so a skinny frame never collapses dialed breast/glute volume (archetypes a, b, g depend on this exclusion).
acceptance_criteria: Channels subcutaneous_fat, rib_visibility, hip_bone_visibility registered as Tissue with masks that are the declared torso/limb regions MINUS breast_l/r and glute_l/r (the exclusion is in the mask definition itself, verifiable by mask set inspection).
Full-range sweeps produce exactly 0.0 mm displacement on breast and glute mask vertices — the exclusion proof, run as part of BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID.

Skinny + max volume combo (archetype a/b core): subcutaneous_fat at max removal + rib_visibility at max + breast_volume 3.0 + glute_volume max evaluates artifact-free; breast/glute silhouettes are unchanged versus the same volumes at default skinny values (delta comparison test).
rib_visibility and hip_bone_visibility produce believable skeletal-visibility geometry at max on the neutral body (fixture snapshot assertion).
All three channels API-addressable with documented ranges.
scope.risk_if_missed: Skinny dials that deflate breasts/glutes are a notorious Daz stacking artifact; without mask-level exclusion the operator's petite-skinny + extreme-volume archetypes (his primary production bodies) self-cancel.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Separate control independence from declared feathered deformation support, skeletal propagation, physical response, and explicit coupling.
